description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for the BuzzLikeOnCommentAPI class in the OrangeHRM project, specifically testing API endpoints related to liking comments on Buzz posts. It defines test methods for retrieving all likes, creating a like, and deleting a like, utilizing data providers for different test scenarios.

classes.name: BuzzLikeOnCommentAPITest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for testing the BuzzLikeOnCommentAPI's CRUD operations related to comment likes within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: testGetAll

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests creating a new like on a comment via the API, using data from the data provider.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests deleting a like on a comment via the API, using data from the data provider.
